commercial_boundary_global: No real supplier booking/PNR/ticket/void/cancel/refund; no wallet/deposit money movement; no supplier credential changes; max 3 live public searches; stop before commercial booking creation.

scenarios.GOAL: Find a suitable flight, understand fare/flight information, proceed only as far as safe before booking creation.
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: routes, APIs, DB, source, test IDs as nav hints, developer tools
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: User can discover search, submit a search, comprehend results/filters/fare cards, understand next CTA, stop before booking write.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: No booking/PNR created; optional read-only search session only.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: No authenticated portal leakage; no internal operator UI.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: Search discoverable within first viewport or primary nav; results understandable without docs.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Search UX completable black-box + stop before booking + no dead end + mobile/desktop sanity.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot find search; results incomprehensible; forced into live booking write; 500/404 dead ends.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: At most 1 of 3 live searches if production-safe; prefer fixture if supplier unavailable.
scenarios.COMMERCIAL_BOUNDARY: STOP before fare selection that creates supplier-writing booking.

scenarios.GOAL: Discover Support, create request, find response, reply, understand open/resolved.
scenarios.STARTING_POINT: Customer account area after login (realistic portal home).
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: Support routes, API paths, ticket IDs from developer sources
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Ticket created; reply found; customer reply sent; status comprehensible; internal notes never visible.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: Support ticket + messages persisted; customer-visible thread only.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: No internal Staff notes; no Admin/Staff-only data.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: Support findable from normal customer nav without route hints.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Black-box create/find/reply + authoritative persistence + no internal leakage.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot discover Support; apparent success without persistence; internal note visible.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: One QA Support ticket create + replies.

scenarios.GOAL: Understand available work/account info; locate bookings/requests; locate eligible finance request without money movement.
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: Admin/Staff routes, other agency IDs, API maps
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Agent navigates portal; understands wallet/request distinction; sees own agency data only.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: No balance change; no deposit approval.
scenarios.EXPECTED_RECIPIENT: N/A for discovery; finance queue if request created (prefer discovery-only if prod clutter risk).
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: No Admin/Staff leakage; no cross-agency data.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: Core areas reachable from visible Agent nav.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Discoverability of bookings/requests/finance surfaces + isolation + no money movement.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot find core areas; sees other agency/Admin data; money moved.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: Prefer black-box form discoverability; domain tests for mutation if needed.
scenarios.COMMERCIAL_BOUNDARY: No wallet credit/debit; no deposit approval.

scenarios.GOAL: Determine attention items, find assigned work, understand state, perform safe next action.
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: Route names, assignment IDs from developer sources
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Assigned work discoverable; safe note/update possible; queue usable after action.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: Safe mutation persisted if performed; stale-state feedback if concurrent.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: Customer-visible vs internal distinction clear; no unauthorized Admin settings.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Discover assigned work black-box + safe action + feedback + authoritative state.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot find assigned work; silent persistence failure; exposes wrong data.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: Internal note or support reply on QA ticket.

scenarios.GOAL: Find new customer request, understand need, respond, manage status without exposing internals.
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: Direct support deep routes as instructions
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Ticket found, reply sent, status clear, internal vs external clear.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: Customer-visible reply persisted; internal notes not in customer thread.
scenarios.EXPECTED_RECIPIENT: Customer thread + ops notifications as designed.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: No unrelated finance data; internal notes stay internal.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Black-box handle ticket + verifier persistence + privacy.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot find ticket; internal exposed; reply not persisted.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: QA ticket reply/status on dedicated QA records.

scenarios.GOAL: Identify finance-related Agent requests for review without moving money; or prove N/A via architecture.
scenarios.STARTING_POINT: Staff portal with finance permission fixture if available.
scenarios.FORBIDDEN_KNOWLEDGE: Hardcoded finance URLs as sole navigation
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Finance queue discoverable OR architecture proves finance RBAC path without inventing department.
scenarios.EXPECTED_RECIPIENT: Finance-capable staff only for finance events.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: Support-only staff do not see finance-only items incorrectly.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: If RBAC exists, queue reachable from visible nav.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: PASS if discoverable safely; PASS_OR_NA_WITH_ARCHITECTURE_PROOF if no separate finance persona in prod RBAC.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Money moved; wrong visibility; invented fake department without proof.

scenarios.GOAL: Determine attention items, find new customer request, assign Staff, monitor progression, understand operational health.
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: New work found; assignment performed; monitoring possible; no legacy dead ends.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: Admin-only surfaces not leaked to other roles in reverse tests.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: Ops awareness from dashboard first glance.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Black-box discover + assign + monitor + authoritative assignment.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Cannot find new work; assignment silent fail; legacy operator UI dead end.
scenarios.ALLOWED_SAFE_MUTATION: Assign QA Staff on QA Support ticket.

scenarios.GOAL: Customer create → Admin assign → Staff reply → Customer reply → Staff handle → Admin observes.
scenarios.STARTING_POINT: Each role realistic home; no internal route coaching.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: Ticket thread + assignment + replies + statuses consistent.
scenarios.SECURITY_EXPECTATION: Internal notes never customer-visible; agency isolation intact.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: Each hop discoverable from role home/inbox.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: All hops black-box success + deterministic verifier.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Any hop requires hidden developer knowledge or fails persistence/routing.

scenarios.GOAL: First-time user can identify location, attention, allowed actions, next action, success, return path.
scenarios.MAX_REASONABLE_FRICTION: No hidden route requirement for core tasks.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Core tasks completable without route coaching.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: P1 if mandatory core requires hidden developer knowledge.

scenarios.GOAL: Lifecycle wording comprehensible across booking/payment/support/assignment/agent request/notifications.
scenarios.EXPECTED_BUSINESS_OUTCOME: Statuses have business meaning; no contradictory actions.
scenarios.EXPECTED_AUTHORITATIVE_STATE: Presentation may improve if semantics authoritative.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: No P0/P1 status misunderstandings in mandatory flows.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_FAIL: Status causes operational error risk without fix; or policy change required (owner decision).

scenarios.GOAL: Safe error/recovery comprehension for validation, 403, 409, refresh, back, duplicate click.

scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Safe exercises comprehensible + no silent corruption.

scenarios.GOAL: Logical IA; current location; mobile nav; important work not buried; role-irrelevant nav absent.

scenarios.GOAL: Feedback after safe actions matches authoritative state.
scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: No false success claims in mandatory actions.

scenarios.GOAL: Natural boundary crossings denied; verifier confirms backend denial.

scenarios.AUTOMATIC_PASS: Mandatory actions completable at representative widths.
